Committee: County and Municipal Government
Sponsor: Ellis
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/22/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 346 as introduced removes the deadline for which local units of government that participate in the Employees Retirement System (ERS) must adopt a resolution to provide Tier I benefits to Tier II members.
According to the actuary for the Retirement Systems of Alabama, this bill will not affect state funding.
Reed Ingram, Chair
County and Municipal Government
